 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Cleveland Browns did themselves a huge favor in the short term with a 27-24 win over the Houston Texans , Sunday, Nov. 14, at Huntington Bank Field.
 The Browns (6-4) painted themselves clearly into the playoff picture with the victory, which put them in the No. 7 spot on the AFC side of the bracket.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement However, it is a comfortable spot to be with the next team — the New England Patriots — being a full game behind.
 What are the standings in the AFC playoff picture?
 1. Buffalo Bills (8-1)
 2. Kansas City Chiefs (7-2)
 3. Jacksonville Jaguars (7-2)
 4. Pittsburgh Steelers (6-2)
 5. Denver Broncos (7-2)
 6. Cincinnati Bengals (6-2)
 7. Cleveland Browns (6-4)
 Who else is in the NFL playoff hunt?
 8. New England Patriots (5-5)
 9. Las Vegas Raiders (4-5)
 10. Baltimore Ravens (4-5)
 Will the Browns face anyone currently in the AFC playoffs?
 The Browns have two games remaining with the Bengals (Dec. 6, Jan. 9/10, 2027), the Las Vegas Raiders (Nov. 27) and Baltimore Ravens (Dec. 27).
